acceptance.assertion: A safely classified read-only GitHub preflight that fails transiently with HTTP 503 is retried only a small fixed number of times and succeeds if a later read returns valid JSON; retry count is deterministic and bounded.
Nicht-read-only GitHub command shapes and non-transient GitHub failures are never retried by the new mechanism and retain the existing fail-closed RuntimeRefreshError semantics.

The retry surface remains wholly before authority binding, attempt-ledger creation and runtime effect start; an existing started.json/result.json or any post-effect uncertainty continues to use the existing no-blind-retry path.

Deterministic tests reproduce repeated HTTP 503 then success, retry exhaustion, non-503 failure, and unsafe command shape without depending on live GitHub flakiness; full Bureau validation remains green.

approval.note: User requested the already-promoted GitHub-GraphQL-503 finding to be fixed; scope is limited to runtime-refresh read-only preflight retry semantics and deterministic tests.

goal: Transiente HTTP-503-Ausfälle bei ausschließlich read-only GitHub-Preflights des Bureau-Runtime-Refresh bounded abfangen, ohne exakte Main-/PR-/CI-Bindungen zu lockern und ohne irgendeinen Runtime-Effekt, Authority-CAS oder bereits begonnenen Attempt erneut auszuführen. Retry ist ausschließlich vor Effektbeginn und nur für sicher klassifizierte Leseoperationen zulässig; nicht-transiente Fehler, nicht-read-only GitHub-Aufrufe, Retry-Erschöpfung sowie jeder bereits persistierte Attempt bleiben fail-closed.

does_not_establish: permission to retry after attempt ledger creation

trigger_evidence.failure: gh pr view GraphQL HTTP 503 before attempt ledger creation
